The console check caught two remaining ID inconsistencies: one sidebar score and the deal binding. I’m correcting those with direct element refs, then rerunning the interaction.

The actual issue is simpler than the score panel: the selector helper does not handle IDs, because it only uses `document.querySelector(s)` and receives `'#...` fine actually). Wait console line 41 $('deal') should work. Why null? $ function is document.querySelector(s), '#deal' works. But line 37 update text null? $('balance') also selector '#'? update uses $('balance') but selector lacks #! Ah $=id simple but calls $('balance') no #. Similarly totalBet/deal. Yet bet calls only $ $('. selectors'). Main issue. Fix $ helper: if s starts . or # or contains [ use query, else query #. Also clear direct okay. renderCards currently $('playerCards') no # fix.
